channel.title: CannyForge
channel.description: AI systems engineering — architecture, agent reliability, LLM economics, and observations from building.

item.title: Teaching Machines to Decide: RL Simulation and the Reward-Hacking Trap
item.description: An RL agent learned to keep 600 vending sites stocked — and found a strategy that beat every human rule while quietly gaming the reward. A hands-on look at RL simulation, reward design, and why your eval loop must measure what you're trading away.

item.title: CannyForge v0.3.1 — FSI Benchmark Release
item.description: 15 multi-turn tool-use scenarios, five scoring dimensions, six failure-mode detectors. No LLM-as-judge. Here's what the numbers actually say — and three things that broke along the way.

item.title: The Last Free Tier
item.description: A fiction about platform dependency, developer lock-in, and what happens when the tools that make you faster make you unable to work without them.

item.title: The State of Agent Frameworks — A 2026 Survey
item.description: A comprehensive 2026 survey of the six agent frameworks that ship to production: OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, and Microsoft Semantic Kernel. Architecture trade-offs, real deployments, and the gaps they have yet to close.

item.title: From Conversation to Knowledge: Temporal Memory Reconstruction
item.description: A grep-first, LLM-second pipeline for recovering design decisions from months of Discord history — with timestamps, decision states, and conflict detection. No vector DB needed.

item.title: DeepSeek-V4: The Economics of the Million-Token Brain
item.description: How a redesigned attention mechanism turns long-context AI from a luxury into a utility — and what it means for the tools developers use every day.

item.title: From Prompt Tweaks to Learning Machines: The Agent Skill Primitive
item.description: How AI agents are evolving from static prompt followers to dynamic learning machines — and what the agent skill primitive means for the future of autonomous systems.

item.title: Beyond the Hype: A Deep Dive into the Systemic, Algorithmic, and Cognitive Roots of the Infinite Software Crisis
item.description: A systems-level analysis of the Infinite Software Crisis, connecting weak guardrails, model training limits, and human cognitive bias to long-term software fragility.

item.title: Designing Agentic Systems: Lessons from LLM Coding Tools
item.description: LLM coding tools are the most demanding test of agentic system design. Here's what building and using them teaches about agents that actually work.

item.title: Context Engineering: The Real Secret to Magical AI Agents
item.description: The difference between a basic AI demo and a magical product isn't the model — it's the context. A practical breakdown of context engineering.

item.title: Best Practices for Agentic Reasoning in Production: Lessons from Anthropic and My Own Experience
item.description: What actually works when deploying agentic reasoning systems in production — lessons distilled from Anthropic's guidance and real-world experience.

item.title: Reverse-Engineering OpenAI’s Deep Research: How to Balance Power with Safety
item.description: A practical reverse-engineering of OpenAI's Deep Research system architecture, with lessons for balancing autonomous capability, reliability, and safety in production.

item.title: Chain-of-Thought vs. ReAct: A Deep Dive into Reasoning Paradigms for Large Language Models
item.description: A rigorous comparison of two dominant reasoning paradigms — when to use each, and what their tradeoffs reveal about how LLMs actually think.

item.title: The Shock of DeepSeek-R1 and the Legacy of Eclipse
item.description: DeepSeek-R1 arrived like a shock to the system. What it means for the frontier, and what history tells us about moments like this.
